programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: The Tigers Return
programs.description: Hull City's return to the Premier League is the latest chapter in a story built on resilience, ambition and belief. We look back on the club's previous adventures in the top-flight, reliving the moments that shaped its identity before looking ahead to an exciting new era. Joining the Tigers at their pre-season training camp in Slovenia, we go behind the scenes to discover how the club is preparing for the challenges ahead.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Coventry Rising
programs.description: We follow Coventry City as they prepare for a long-awaited return to the Premier League, ending a 25-year absence from English football's top flight. With exclusive access during the club's pre-season training camp in Málaga, we go behind the scenes as players and staff build towards a landmark campaign filled with anticipation and expectation.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Petr Cech
programs.description: One of the Premier League's greatest-ever goalkeepers, Petr Čech's career was nearly changed forever by the horrific head injury he suffered in 2006. We sit down with him to discuss his remarkable recovery and journey back to the very top, before discovering how his competitive drive has continued, with the Czech shot-stopper swapping football for a new challenge playing Ice Hockey.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Amad Diallo
programs.description: From his early years in Ivory Coast to leaving Africa for Europe, Amad Diallo's journey has been one of talent, determination and sacrifice. After making his breakthrough in Italy, his potential earned him a dream move to Manchester United, where he has fought to establish himself on the Premier League stage. We follow Amad's remarkable rise and the journey that has taken him from humble beginnings to the heights of Old Trafford.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: John Stones
programs.description: John Stones has experienced almost everything the game can offer; from the pressure of the biggest stage to the injuries and setbacks that have tested him along the way. After more than a decade at the heart of the Premier League, winning its biggest honours and helping redefine the role of a modern defender, he now takes his career in a new direction.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Granit Xhaka
programs.description: From his family's courageous journey in search of a better future to becoming one of Europe's most respected midfielders, this is the story of Granit Xhaka. We chart his rise through the game, the highs and lows of a career that tested his resilience, and the turbulent relationship with Arsenal supporters that ultimately became one of football's greatest redemption stories.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Roberto Mancini
programs.description: From a celebrated playing career in Italy to becoming the man who transformed Manchester City into Premier League champions, Roberto Mancini's footballing life has been filled with triumph, drama and unforgettable characters. PL Stories explores his fiery relationship with Mario Balotelli, 'that' extraordinary final-day victory over QPR, and the deep friendship he shared with the late Gianluca Vialli.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: The Evolution of Goalkeepers
programs.description: Once the last line of defence, today's goalkeeper is expected to be so much more. From sweeper-keepers to playing out under pressure, we explore the innovations, characters and changing demands that have revolutionised one of football's most fascinating positions.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Marcus Stewart: The Fight of My Life
programs.description: Ipswich Town legend and former Sunderland striker Marcus Stewart built a career on taking on some of football's toughest challenges. Now, he faces a very different battle; one that has changed his life beyond the pitch and revealed a strength and determination far greater than anything football demanded of him.
